scripts.build: tsc -b && npm run package:windows && vite build
scripts.package:windows: npm run generate:legal && npm run generate:pages && node scripts/package-windows.mjs
scripts.bench: rolldown scripts/bench/engineBench.ts --platform node --file node_modules/.cache/bench/engine.mjs --log-level silent && node node_modules/.cache/bench/engine.mjs
scripts.bench:season: rolldown scripts/bench/seasonBench.ts --platform node --file node_modules/.cache/bench/season.mjs --log-level silent && node node_modules/.cache/bench/season.mjs
